candidates: In story `play` functions (and any other test utilities in this codebase), never directly force-cast a `querySelector` result to `HTMLElement`. Instead, capture the result in a named variable, assert it is non-null with a descriptive error (e.g., `if (!el) throw new Error('#storybook-panel-root not found')`), and only then pass it to `within()` or other DOM APIs. Direct `as HTMLElement` casts mask null returns and produce confusing downstream failures.

When a story's `beforeEach` hook patches any global or prototype value (e.g., `global.PREVIEW_URL`, `Storage.prototype.getItem`, `window.*`), capture the original value in a module-level constant *before* mutation and unconditionally restore it in the corresponding `afterEach` hook. Every mutated value must have a matching restore — omitting any one of them leaks state across stories and test runs.

Before merging a PR that bumps a package to a new major version, verify the package's changelog and release notes for breaking changes: renamed packages or CLI flags, removed APIs, changed configuration schemas, and updated peer-dependency requirements. Confirm that the repository's usage (scripts, config files, CI inputs) has been updated accordingly and that a local build completes successfully before the PR is approved.
